column1: # Accepted equivalent mutants: mutants no test can kill because the mutated program behaves identically.
# One per line, TAB separated: class <TAB> line <TAB> mutator simple name <TAB> reason <TAB> approved by <TAB> date
# The reason must say why no input can tell the two versions apart. Only the user approves entries.
# quality_report.py reports the raw score and the score with these accepted; PIT's own gate uses the raw score.
